newsitem.title: UK: Guinness says expects steady progress.
newsitem.headline: Guinness says expects steady progress.

text.p: Drinks group Guinness Plc said on Wednesday it expected to report steady progress in profit performance for 1996.
Chairman Tony Greener said "I am pleased that after substantially increased investment, our 1996 results will represent steady growth in profit performance for the year..."
The group's spirits arm United Distillers has achieved its main targets for 1996 -- growing volume, increasing prices and raising investment in its brands while maintaining profits, said the company.

Guinness also said its brewing business has traded strongly with notable sales increases in Guinness stout and Kilkenny Irish Ale and a further profits growth after another increase in brand investment.
